defects.F8: when cross-field admission invariants failed, the events were refused but sessionLifecycle, eventPageCoverage and completeness were computed from the page and the admission flag alone, so a contradictory binding could still report SESSION_READ + FULL + COMPLETE
defects.F14: a Caller Claim that differed from the verified SessionId was recorded but the discrepancy was not reported as a discrepancy

correction.invariantGating: src/trajectory/handoff_preview.ts — when invariantsRefused, sessionLifecycle is derived from the claim/binding state (not from the page's read state) and eventPageCoverage becomes NOT_APPLICABLE, so completeness can no longer reach COMPLETE through a refused page
correction.claimDisagreement: src/composition/attributed_preview.ts — when the caller's claimed id differs from the verified SessionId, a CALLER_DECLARATION evidence ref is added and the binding detail states the claim DISAGREES and is retained only as a declaration; the verified SessionId remains the only read target
correction.epistemicNotErasure: the read attempt, when it occurred, remains visible as non-authoritative diagnostic evidence; only its classification changes
